adjudication.family_description: A Finnish customer pays a sales invoice through MobilePay; the settlement arrives net of the fee with a settlement report.
adjudication.error_mode: fee-netted payout: exact arithmetic; a ten-cent discrepancy; two captures in one settlement
adjudication.label_reason: The report names the invoice and a 2,64 € fee, but the bank credit is 237,26 €, ten cents below gross minus fee, and no source explains the difference: the evidence is present and the discrepancy needs a judgment.
adjudication.terminal_reason: RULE-BLOCKED (second review, 2026-09-18): every document exists and the arithmetic does not close by ten cents, but the contract refuses the link mechanically (relationship_amount_conflict) before any semantic answer is consulted — ideal and unknown answers escalate identically — so this case cannot establish whether Jev could decide it; it measures the rule, and is reported as underdetermined, never as a measured reasoning limitation.
